title: 云计算和SaaS领域的技术进展与结构性变化
core_insight: AWS、Salesforce、Google Cloud和Azure等云计算和SaaS领域的领先者在AI、数据分析和基础设施方面取得了显著进展，推动了企业的数字化转型和市场需求的变化

dimension_texts.technology: AWS推出Amazon Bedrock AgentCore，Google Cloud的BigQuery Graphs和post-quantum cryptography roadmap体现了云原生和安全技术的进展 AWS DynamoDB现在支持实时向量搜索，具有单位毫秒级延迟和99%+的召回率，Google Cloud的Gemini Enterprise和Database Migration Service更新反映了基础设施的改进 AWS Weekly Roundup: AWS Heroes Summit, Web Search on Amazon Bedrock, Dogwood, Kiro Crew, and more (August 10, 2026) What’s new with Google Cloud PQC in Plaintext: Google Cloud’s post-quantum cryptography roadmap The Economics of Agent Optimization: From pilots to measurable returns 火山引擎正式推出四款数据产品 将持续完善敏捷数智引擎矩阵 Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language Amazon DynamoDB now supports real-time vector search at any scale Expanding connectivity in the Americas: Introducing Alisios, Canoa, and OlaLuz subsea cables AT&T and Microsoft scale trillion-token workloads with Microsoft Foundry and AMD
dimension_texts.infrastructure: AWS推出Local Zone在雅典，扩大区域覆盖，Google Cloud的Alisios、Canoa和OlaLuz子海缆项目扩展了其基础设施 AWS提供了更多关于算力供应和GPU支持的信息，Google Cloud的Developer Device Platform为移动应用开发提供了新的基础设施支持 AWS Weekly Roundup: Local Zone in Athens, Claude Opus 5 on AWS, Lambda durable execution for .NET, and more (July 27, 2026) Expanding connectivity in the Americas: Introducing Alisios, Canoa, and OlaLuz subsea cables Introducing the Developer Device Platform for agentic mobile app development 布局云计算，火山引擎的技术发展之路
